identityGuarantees.compositePrimaryKey: match_over_snapshots(match_id, innings, over_num), match_dismissal_snapshots(match_id, innings, wicket_num)
identityGuarantees.crossMatchProtection: Querying getRunsInOver / getScoreAtDismissal with foreign match_id returns null, preventing cross-match corruption.
identityGuarantees.tokenBinding: Authorization tokens cryptographically bind matchId + betId + marketId into the SHA-256 evidenceHash.
